title: Permit Map
user: Engineers using coding agents across several repositories who need to see the effective allow/deny policy before an agent runs.
smallest_useful_product: A local CLI that reads configured agent policy files, resolves precedence into an allow/deny table, highlights shadowed rules, and emits a reviewable Markdown report.
constraints: Parse only local configuration; never read secret values; adapters must clearly state unsupported precedence semantics.
summary: Resolve coding-agent permissions before an agent runs.
